_comment: The single source of every pinned native version. Every other copy (Gradle, Package.swift, example app, CI) is asserted against this file by test/native_versions_test.dart.

flutter.provenance: The plugin is SwiftPM-only (no podspec), so `flutter pub get` fails on Linux/Windows before 3.41.0 ('only Swift Package Manager compatible'); measured on CI across 3.27-3.38, first passing release 3.41.0. For reference, competitor floors (pub.dev, 2026-10-20): Sentry 3.44, Firebase/Datadog 3.27, Bugsnag/Shake/Embrace 3.10, Instabug 1.17.

android.provenance: Maven Central latest, 2026-10-20. Gradle plugin must be >= 4.0.7 (workbook 1.4).

jdk.provenance: Gradle 8.14 in the Flutter template cannot parse JDK 25 (Android Studio's bundled JBR); use 17 or 21.
